title: Magnesium Supplements May Not Reach the Brain
excerpt: Despite marketing claims on supplement labels, various magnesium variants sold today may not actually penetrate the brain.
body_html:
Numerous magnesium supplements currently on the market include claims on their labels stating they can penetrate the brain's gray matter. However, biological realities do not necessarily align with these marketing declarations.

Despite the promises made by manufacturers regarding these different variants, scientific biology limits how effectively certain substances can reach the brain, questioning the accuracy of these supplement marketing claims.
